item.description: The Flask integration is not properly capturing and associating HTTP requests with their corresponding Flask route handlers. The current implementation stores route information on functions but doesn't properly integrate with Flask's internal request routing mechanism to ensure that incoming requests are correctly mapped to their decorated handlers.
item.contract: Flask route handlers must be properly intercepted and associated with their route patterns so that when HTTP requests come in, they are correctly linked to the appropriate route handler function with accurate labels for both the route pattern and the function call with parameters.
